reason: A terminal-based DeepSeek Harness client focused on interactive agent conversations, session management, streaming responses, and user-directed tool and shell-command execution.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端智能体客户端，提供类 Claude Code 对话、类 Vim 模态输入、会话管理、流式回复以及工具调用交互。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness terminal agent client that provides Claude Code-style conversations, Vim-like modal input, session management, streaming responses, and tool-call interactions.

capabilities: Provides an interactive terminal UI for agent conversations
Streams agent responses and tool-call events
Maintains, resumes, and switches conversation sessions
Allows users to reference workspace files in prompts
Passes user-requested shell commands to the agent for execution
Connects to a locally running DSH HTTP host
